Profit & Loss A/C for 4th Quarter of 2072-73 and the corresponding Balance Sheet are attached. Data provided for the 4th Quarter is for

Directors for the period ended on Ashad 2073 that may have a potential conflict with the interests of the company at large. However, Mr.
Ravi Bhakta Shrestha, Director and representative of JV partner Sibkrim Land & Industrial Company Pvt. Ltd. has business relation with
the company through third party operations.
b)  Earnings Per Share, P/E Ratio, Net worth per share and ratio of liquidity.
Earnings Per Share:
For the 4th Qtr of Year of 2072-73 is Rs. 1139 against Rs. 344 of previous year same period. EPS for the quarter is high because of  0
the impact of correction of allocation to Housing fund. As suggested by the auditors, the housing fund alocation has been taken as an
appropriation from profit instead of charge to P&L and hence the amount is abnormally high for the quarter.

2)  Analysis of Management
Company's turnover for current quarter has increased by 8.7% over same period of previous year.Net profit for the quarter hasalso increased
by 190% over same period of previous year because of impact of correction of allocation to Housing fund. As suggested by the auditors, the
housing fund allocation has been taken as an appropriation from profit instead of charge to P&L and hence the amount is abnormally high for
the quarter.Net profit for the quarter would have increased by 43% if the impact of housing fund correction done in Q4 is removed.

Management Analysis
>  Mai and Mai Cascade Hydropower Plants have evacuated its power on the basis of dispatch availability in the 1st quarter of the fiscal year 2081/82.
>  Revenue from the Sale of Electricity has decreased by 20.81% comparec  nding   previous year's quarter ending. Decrease in energy is caused due to damage of
four numbers of NEA's 132 kV Kabeli corridor line. NEA could not offtake power from Sanima Mai as well as almost 20 more IPPs during the maintenance of those four damaged
towers which lasted for a period of 37 days from Ashwin 12, 2081t  to Kartik  19,2081
The net profit for the first quarter end of FY 2081/082 has decreased by 20.09% compared to the previous year's quarter ending.
Financial income has decreased by 80.84% and financial costs have decreased  16.17% compared to the corresponding previous year's quarter ending.
